items.text: Made saving more consistent to prevent getting into bad world states.

Fixed a progression blocker during “In Darkness The Truth Will Be Revealed” where players would some times not be able to interact with the exit ladder. This should retroactive fix saves for people who were previously stuck.
Fixed a progression blocker during “Deciphering Melodies” where one side of the music box puzzle could become non-interactable. This should retroactive fix saves for people who were previously stuck.
Fixed a progression blocker during “Off The Rails” where you would not be able to pick up some of the gears during the first puzzle.

Fixed a progression blocker during “Memory Leak” where chemicals went missing in the world. Steam Hotfix 1 (Nov 5) prevented new instances of this bug, this should retroactive fix saves for people who were already stuck.
Fixed a progression blocker during “Chortkoff’s Gun” where the theater ticket could go missing. This should retroactive fix saves for people who were previously stuck.

Fixed a soft progression blocker during “Quanty: Rebooted” where one of the spinner locks was so wide in French, that it was very hard to interact with the last spinner as it was clipping into the wall.
Fixed a UX bug during “Banding Together” where the trombone was not opening as expected.
Fixed Bert Chumpin missing the extra credit marker above his head after obtaining a bag of Dokeytos for him.
Fixed a wrong text box appearing on the Science Campus crane between “The First Chamber” and “Von Boyage”
Fixed an incorrect hint appearing during “Eyes on the Prize” if you activate the laser before solving the jigsaw.
Fixed the orange flowers being in the wrong column on the stone tablet during “Pushing up Daisies”
Fixed a bug during “Quanty: Rebooted” where selecting “See ya!” at the end of some dialogue trees would not properly close the dialogue UI.
Fixed Bravius Loomy from having “test student” dialogue during Chapter 7.
Fixed a bug where the insides of the Greenhouse did not get loaded if you ziplined onto it from the Headmaster’s Tower.
Fixed a potted plant collision trap on the Arts Campus.
Fixed a journal bug where the 2nd step of “Rewriting History” was not getting checked off.
Fixed a bug where online lobbies would some times fail to be created.
Fixed a bug in the room “Lightbulb Moment” where the marble didn’t have enabled physics on first load.
Fixed a bug in the room “Mind Your Elders” where the hidden achievement didn’t trigger on room replays.
Fixed a bug during the quest “Quanty: Rebooted” where players were no longer able to pick up Quanty if they left the area in the middle of the quest.
Thanks for joining us on our first school day! We’ve been monitoring bug reports, and made a few immediate hot fixes, based on the feedback so far:
Fixed a bug where saving & exiting midway through the “Memory Leak” questline could permanently delete the brain/drain chemicals from the world. Your chemicals should now be safe!
Fixed a similar bug during the “Rest in Paint” questline, where stencils/paints could be deleted from the world if you saved + quit midway thru the quest.
Fixed dialogue with Izzy Dizzy (the clown). He was previously giving you some of Cod Stewart (the fisherman)’s dialogue lines.
The new version number is v1.0.20261105.001.
If you encounter any other issues while playing, please feel free report them on the Steam Forum, or drop us a message in our Discord channel! We’ll keep monitoring and patching as we catch things!
-Coin Crew Games
Hey Escapists!
We are full steam ahead towards release on November 5th. Mark it in your calendar
Ahead of launch we're pushing out an update to the demo. Below are the patch notes:
* Performance Improvements.
Large strides have been made on the performance front. If you've played the old demo and the performance hasn't been up to snuff, please give the new demo a whirl.
* Localization updates and bug fixes.
We were a bit mid-stream with the last batch of translations and localization QA so the old demo ended up with several localization bugs. But they should all be ironed out now.
* Removed save wiping at the end of the demo.

Now that we're close enough to release we can be confident that save files won't break between the demo and release (fingers crossed). Apologies to everyone who played the old demo and will have to redo the first ~1 hour of the game.
* UX and clueing updates based on player feedback in the levels "A Clued Awakening" and "That Rings a Bell".
* Miscellaneous bug fixes.
I'll be real, there have been too many bug fixes between when we first put the demo up and now to reasonably make the whole list, but trust me there's been a bunch of fixes.
That's it from us for this update. Please checkout out the updated demo and leave us your feedback.
LOOKIN' FORWARD TO LAUNCH Y'ALL! (it's November 5th)

items.text: [img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45649515/74f8463cf96fec2bec630f79de8f0c24fade71f8.png"]

And speaking of that release we’ve had some internal puzzling talks and have decided to move Escape Academy 2’s release date to November to give the final push to launch as much polish and the best chance to reach as many players as possible!
But that’s not all…
[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45649515/61b6a5ee1bebad4c6603d5a6c1092e12b583e8e1.png"]

Escape Academy 2 is headed to Gamescom! We’ll be showcasing the game at the Indie Arena Booth and sharing the excitement across social media as we introduce and re-introduce players to the world of Escape Academy.
If you’re headed to Gamescom be sure to check out the Indie Arena Booth (which you can find on this handy map, we DO love maps)!
See you soon, Escapists!

releases.displayName: Escape Academy 2 - Demo NextFest Patch Notes | June 16 '26

items.text: Hey Escapists!
[p align="start"]
[p align="start"]In order to make the NextFest celebration as smooth as it can be, we’ve got some bug fixes coming to the Escape Academy 2: Back 2 School demo. Take a peek below:
[p align="start"]
Fixed a bug where the walls of the bookstore were mysteriously absent.
Fixed a bug causing Ralph Wrexler’s trophies to disappear from existence upon reloading a save.
Fixed another bug where Ralph Wrexler would rearrange the correctly sorted trophies when you weren’t looking.
The cafeteria doors now align properly when they close, and no longer disappear when viewed from the improper angle.
Fixed an issue where the hint for the Chapter 1 book quest was giving the full solution.
You can now pick up the Red Herring on the bookshelf near the Headmaster’s office.
Credit doors have their outline again.
Added an autosave point between the tutorial level and first escape room.
Fixed glass textures in the tutorial level.
So many occlusion culling fixes.
Removed some items from the dorm that should not be visible until later in the game.
Adjusted the bell’s position at the end of Reina Wym’s Clocktower Exam.
That's all from us for today.
See you in the next one, Escapists!
Coin Crew Games💛💜
